title: Canonical Observation Event
description: Terra Pay X canonical observation event (GIP-1-A). A strict envelope with an open metadata body. Top-level fields are fixed; 'metadata' is the sanctioned open extension point. The event carries observed facts only — never scores, verdicts, confidence, or interpretation (interpretation lives downstream in CGP-3's Confidence Assessment). Contract version 1.0.0.

allOf.description: Identity anchor rule: at least one of visitorId, userId, or organizationId must be present, so every observation is attributable.

eventId.description: Globally unique, producer-generated id for this single observation. Idempotency key: redelivery of the same eventId is the same observation and must be de-duplicated downstream.

eventType.description: Canonical event name: domain.entity.action, lowercase, past-tense action. Domain is one of the six canonical domains. A product may only emit a value already defined in the contract (the standing contract-first rule).

occurredAt.description: When the observed thing happened (event time, not ingest time). RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with an explicit offset; UTC 'Z' preferred.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the observation contract this event conforms to.

visitorId.description: Anonymous, pseudonymous device/browser/agent identity. Root of the identity progression.

sessionId.description: One bounded interaction under a visitorId.

userId.description: Identified/authenticated person. Its co-presence with visitorId is the stitching signal.

organizationId.description: Tenant/account the user belongs to. Maps to merchantId in Terra Pay X merchant tenancy. Frequently the sole anchor on operational (system-origin) events.

source.description: Marketing acquisition origin (e.g. google, newsletter, referral, direct). NOT the origin system (which is sourcePlatform in the commerce schema).

medium.description: Channel class of the acquisition origin (e.g. organic, cpc, email, social, referral, direct).

campaignId.description: Stable id (not display name) of the campaign that produced the touch.

experimentId.description: Experiment the actor is enrolled in for this event (GI-4 traceability).

variantId.description: Variant/arm of experimentId shown to the actor. Meaningful only alongside experimentId.

page.description: Web/screen context where the event occurred. Surface (web vs app) lives here, never in the event name.

resource.description: The domain object the event concerns (e.g. checkout, order, product, paymentLink).

metadata.description: Open extension point: free-form, event-specific observed facts (never interpretation). Keys are lowerCamelCase; monetary values are integer minor units with an explicit currency, never floats.
